column1: # test-stub-baseline.tsv — per-file count of inline #! stub writes under tests/: rule R4's ceiling.
# Each exec of a #! stub by path leaks ~1.1 KiB of kernel memory on macOS 15.8.1 until reboot.
# scripts/test-stub-lint.sh refuses any file whose count EXCEEDS its row here (absent = 0).
# Convert a stub with cc_stub DIR NAME BODY (tests/helpers/cc-stub.bash), then lock the decrease
# in with: scripts/test-stub-lint.sh --write-baseline. Columns: <path>TAB<count>, LC_ALL=C order.
